lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance centroids are arranged in a multi-linear grid posterior to the gill slits. Primary clusters form approximately parallel horizontal tracks with inter-blob spacing of roughly 1.5 to 2.0 blob diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows. Nodes are formed where these vertical gradients align with the high-intensity circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant longitudinal feature is visible on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance pixels superiorly to lower-luminance pixels inferiorly.
